## Arithmetic

| Function | Description                                                           |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `add`    | Add two numbers.                                                      |
| `sub`    | Subtract the second number from the first.                            |
| `mul`    | Multiply two numbers.                                                 |
| `mod`    | Return the remainder after division; throws when the divisor is zero. |
| `div`    | Divide two numbers; throws when the divisor is zero.                  |
| `neg`    | Negate a number.                                                      |
| `abs`    | Return the absolute value of a number.                                |
| `floor`  | Round a number down to the nearest integer.                           |
| `ceil`   | Round a number up to the nearest integer.                             |
| `round`  | Round a number to the nearest integer.                                |
| `max`    | Return the largest number in a non-empty array.                       |
| `min`    | Return the smallest number in a non-empty array.                      |
| `sum`    | Sum an array of numbers, returning zero for an empty array.           |
| `sqrt`   | Return the square root of a number.                                   |
| `pow`    | Raise a base to an exponent.                                          |

## Comparison

| Function | Description                                                           |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `eq`     | Test two values for structural equality.                              |
| `neq`    | Test two values for structural inequality.                            |
| `lt`     | Test whether the first number is less than the second.                |
| `lte`    | Test whether the first number is less than or equal to the second.    |
| `gt`     | Test whether the first number is greater than the second.             |
| `gte`    | Test whether the first number is greater than or equal to the second. |

## Logic

| Function | Description                                           |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `not`    | Return the logical negation of a boolean.             |
| `and`    | Return the eager logical conjunction of two booleans. |
| `or`     | Return the eager logical disjunction of two booleans. |

## Strings

| Function     | Description                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `upper`      | Convert a string to uppercase.                                                 |
| `lower`      | Convert a string to lowercase.                                                 |
| `trim`       | Remove whitespace from both ends of a string.                                  |
| `strcat`     | Concatenate any number of strings.                                             |
| `split`      | Split a string on a separator.                                                 |
| `join`       | Join an array's elements with a separator.                                     |
| `startsWith` | Test whether a string starts with a prefix.                                    |
| `endsWith`   | Test whether a string ends with a suffix.                                      |
| `replace`    | Replace all literal, non-overlapping occurrences of a non-empty search string. |
| `padStart`   | Left-pad a string to a Unicode code-point length.                              |

## Arrays

| Function   | Description                                                                            |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `length`   | Return the length of an array or string.                                               |
| `head`     | Return the first element of an array, or null when empty.                              |
| `last`     | Return the last element of an array, or null when empty.                               |
| `tail`     | Return all but the first element of an array.                                          |
| `reverse`  | Return a reversed copy of an array.                                                    |
| `take`     | Return the first requested number of array elements.                                   |
| `drop`     | Return an array without its first requested number of elements.                        |
| `zip`      | Pair corresponding elements, stopping at the shorter array.                            |
| `unique`   | Keep the first occurrence of each structurally distinct array value.                   |
| `repeat`   | Repeat an array or string a non-negative number of times.                              |
| `flatten`  | Flatten an array by one level.                                                         |
| `concat`   | Concatenate any number of arrays.                                                      |
| `range`    | Create an array of integers from zero up to, but excluding, an endpoint.               |
| `slice`    | Return a slice of an array or string.                                                  |
| `includes` | Test an array for a structurally equal value, or a string for a substring.             |
| `indexOf`  | Find a structurally equal array value or string substring, returning null when absent. |
| `setAt`    | Return an array with one element replaced.                                             |

## Objects

| Function      | Description                                                                     |

| `keys`        | Return an object's keys.                                                        |
| `values`      | Return an object's values.                                                      |
| `entries`     | Return an object's key-value pairs.                                             |
| `fromEntries` | Create an object from key-value pairs.                                          |
| `merge`       | Shallowly merge two objects, with the second object's values winning conflicts. |

## Higher-Order Functions

| Function           | Description                                                                |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `map`              | Transform each array element with a callback.                              |
| `mapIndexed`       | Transform each array element with a callback that also receives its index. |
| `filter`           | Keep array elements for which a callback returns true.                     |
| `filterIndexed`    | Keep array elements using a callback that also receives each index.        |
| `reduce`           | Fold an array into an accumulator.                                         |
| `reduceIndexed`    | Fold an array with a callback that also receives each index.               |
| `find`             | Return the first array element matching a callback, or null.               |
| `findIndexed`      | Find an array element with a callback that also receives each index.       |
| `findIndex`        | Return the index of the first callback match, or null.                     |
| `findIndexIndexed` | Find a matching index with a callback that also receives each index.       |
| `some`             | Test whether any array element matches a callback.                         |
| `someIndexed`      | Test for a match with a callback that also receives each index.            |
| `every`            | Test whether every array element matches a callback.                       |
| `everyIndexed`     | Test every element with a callback that also receives each index.          |
| `count`            | Count array elements matching a callback.                                  |
| `countIndexed`     | Count matches with a callback that also receives each index.               |
| `sort`             | Return a sorted copy of an array, optionally using a comparator.           |
| `sortBy`           | Return an array sorted by callback-produced keys.                          |
| `sortByIndexed`    | Sort by keys from a callback that also receives each index.                |
| `groupBy`          | Group array elements by callback-produced keys.                            |
| `groupByIndexed`   | Group by keys from a callback that also receives each index.               |
| `flatMap`          | Transform array elements and flatten array results by one level.           |
| `flatMapIndexed`   | Flat-map with a callback that also receives each index.                    |
| `mapValues`        | Transform an object's values with a callback.                              |
| `apply`            | Call a function with an array of positional arguments.                     |
| `pipe`             | Pass a value through an array of functions from left to right.             |
| `reReplaceWith`    | Replace all regex matches using a callback.                                |

## Regex

| Function     | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `reTest`     | Test whether a regex pattern matches anywhere in a string. |
| `reMatch`    | Return the first regex match object, or null.              |
| `reMatchAll` | Return all non-overlapping regex match objects.            |
| `reReplace`  | Replace all regex matches using a replacement string.      |
| `reSplit`    | Split a string using a regex pattern.                      |
